instruction: Software launch locations: FreeCAD: `/usr/bin/freecad`; LibreCAD: `/usr/bin/librecad`; KiCad: `/home/user/Applications/kicad-10.0.2/kicad-10.0.2-x86_64.AppImage`. Choose the appropriate tool from FreeCAD, LibreCAD, and KiCad, available in the current Ubuntu environment, to complete the task. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih09_pipe_spool_seed.dxf. Complete the hard pipe spool orthographic drawing. Add PIPE center segments (0,80)-(90,80), (130,120)-(230,120), and (270,80)-(340,80). Add PIPE elbow arcs center (110,100) radius 28.284 start 225 end 45 and center (250,100) radius 28.284 start 135 end 315. Add FLANGE circles radius 18 and PIPE bore circles radius 10 at (0,80) and (340,80). Add SUPPORT rectangles (70,30)-(96,62), (180,30)-(206,62), and (290,30)-(316,62). Add NOTE balloon circles radius 8 at (20,115) and (315,115) plus labels SPOOL P-17, DN80 SCH40, 1, 2, and 3X SUPPORTS. Save the completed drawing deliverable into `/home/user/Desktop/result`.
